notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]The Cub - Deluxe Edition[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games, The Cub - Deluxe Edition included, at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2][b]About The Cub - Deluxe Edition[/b][/h2]

Play as The Cub and embark on a journey across a neon-lit apocalypse Earth, filled with stories and clues, only to have it interrupted when the hunt for you begins.
Explore the ruins of humanity after the Great Ecological Catastrophe in a world brought to you by the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Accompanied by Radio Nostalgia from Mars, filled with great tracks and captivating stories, The Cub offers an immersive gaming experience.

Deluxe Edition includes:

[*] The Cub

[*] The Cub Soundtrack
immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with this musical masterpiece: enjoy a whole variety of tracks written and co-composed with many artists including Igor Simic, who is the writer and director of the game itself.

[h3]Wanna crank up those nostalgia vibes even further? Check out [b]The Cub + Golf Club Nostalgia bundle![/b] A ruined Earth won’t ruin your fun in this package!
[/h3]
[*]In Golf Club Nostalgia, return to a desolate Earth for a few rounds of golf. After all, that’s what rich people do right? Listen to the sounds of Radio Nostalgia and piece together just what happened to the people of this once prosperous planet. 

[*]The Cub is a 2D platforming adventure that continues the story of Golf Club Nostalgia. As a child hunted by the former inhabitants of Earth, you must evade capture and return home. Run, jump, crouch and slide your way out of trouble.  Use your environment to your advantage. After all, this is your home now. 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38057/The_Cub__Golf_Club_Nostalgia/
[hr][/hr]

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with The Cub - Deluxe Edition:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38039/The_Cub_Deluxe_Edition/ 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38057/The_Cub__Golf_Club_Nostalgia/

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/ff5c1af5dc7fe7570121d3c80d993df2fcb41e7a.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow adventurers![/h3]
[h3]Join us as we embrace the enchantment of this season, guided by the playful gaming sprite. Discover upcoming releases, essential must-haves, and timeless classics from Untold Tales, all tailored for your home entertainment. 
Let the joyous gaming journey bloom anew![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/df864d4d04cf4aa448996217a57ee2ca496e5e69.png[/img]
[b]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following titles:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/
[h3]Navigate a neon-lit apocalypse in a fusion of Jungle Book meets The Armageddon, brought to you by the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a hunted child, while catchy end-of-day tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551920/Tools_Up_Ultimate_Edition/
[h3]Dive into chaos-filled, local couch-coop extravaganza, all about renovating homes and the outdoors. It comes with all updates, content, and DLC in one package, supporting up to 4 players.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/3613a9f06b81f58ac9909d2037ffde00bd1b7844.png[/img]
[h3]And soon we will have a new task for you - lift the box and ensure its safe journey out of the factory. 
How difficult could it be, right? 
But the real test awaits amidst the conveyor belt chaos of Ready, Steady, Ship! 
Team up with a friend and prepare to step up the pace for the imminent release!

[b]Wishlist and Play the Demo now[/b][/h3]

notes.title: The Cub | Playable demo out now!
notes.content:
[h2]Well hello all you Martians out there. [/h2]

Fantastic news. We just got a hefty supply drop of content here on Mars to keep you sane as you begin to question our very existence up here on this dead red planet. 

First off is a demo for The Cub. Get snippets of 3 different levels, a microdose of the next wave of Radio Nostalgia From Mars and a teaser of the story to come. Download that software right into your retinas.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/

And remember, if you enjoyed the demo do please spread the word or toss a wishlist and follow our way. 

- The Cub Team

> End of transmission
